cpu.scope: Total inferior process CPU since launch, including loader work. Final unobserved wall bounds missing CPU; the observer does not affect native execution or debugger state.

selfbuild.scope: The before/after Node hosts emitted byte-identical native compilers; one native execution establishes their common stage-image fixed point. No native compiler performance gain is claimed; same exact TypeScript source and identical emitted compiler bytes. Operation benchmarks provide repeated CPU medians. Both stage-1 hosts are frozen production implementations. Workspace and native fixture gates remain required.

before.scope: Explicit variant subset. Selected variants only; no whole-suite coverage claim. Each supported variant runs in an isolated native process. Synchronous and Promise-job asynchronous Scripts use parsed strictness and unchanged harness sources. Parse/early-negative tests use native syntax validation without evaluation. Unsupported module execution, agents, lowering and runtime operations, as well as harness errors, crashes and timeouts remain in the totals. Runtime-compiled tagged templates retain parsed-unit site identity and use the existing realm template cache. Runtime compilation uses the image-owned import helper and checked referrer views. This run leaves the module loader disabled; static and dynamic module loading remain unsupported.
before.variantPolicy: Every explicit manifest entry validated against pinned paths, source hashes and syntaxVariants; raw/strict/sloppy/module flags retained; fixture files excluded. Syntax-negative files precede execution files, preserving file order within each lane. No unsupported or failed variants excluded from the denominator.

compilation.failurePolicy: A failed batch compilation is retained for every affected variant; no automatic retry.
